scientific_scope_status: For the specified connected family of frustrated-trimer blocks with rational PSD links, every paired imaginary-time endpoint is nonnegative while the exact paired Schur/first-return operator has an unremovable triangle sign. AtU=1, literal-boundary homogeneous positive submarkov approximations have Laplace-operator error at least1/7868 independent of block count. A separate high-occupation Gibbs bound limits bare paired-sector weight to1/M at fixedM,beta,U.
